北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 多云天气好，记得保持好心情，轻松出行哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: A pleasant cloudy day, keep a good mood and enjoy your outing!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波中雨，风力强。体感较凉，出门带伞，注意防风保暖。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo has moderate rain and strong winds. Feels cool, take umbrella, stay warm.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 中雨来袭，风力稍大。出门带伞，注意添衣，别着凉啦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Moderate rain and wind. Take an umbrella, add clothes to avoid catching a cold.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 艳阳高照，天气炎热。注意防晒补水，小心中暑哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and hot. Remember sun protection, hydrate, and prevent heatstroke!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴热，高温持续。多喝水，防晒避暑，小心高温。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and hot. Drink water, protect from sun, avoid heat.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 大风大雨，体感很冷。出门务必穿暖带伞，注意防风。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Strong winds and heavy rain, feels very cold. Dress warmly, take an umbrella, stay safe.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 小雨绵绵，湿度高。出门带伞，路滑小心，保持好心情。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Light rain and high humidity. Remember your umbrella, watch for slippery roads, stay happy.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 体感炎热，多云也需防暑。记得防晒补水，小心热哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Feels very hot. Protect from sun, hydrate. Even cloudy, watch for heatstroke.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，温度较高。注意补充水分，出门戴帽防晒。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and warm. Remember to hydrate, wear a hat for sun protection.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，温度适宜。注意补水，保持愉快，享受美好一天。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy with pleasant temperature. Stay hydrated and enjoy your day.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，体感稍热。多喝水，注意休息，保持活力哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels a bit warm. Remember to drink water, rest, and stay energetic.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，天气宜人。出门感受凉爽，保持好心情哦。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy with pleasant weather. Enjoy the cool air and stay cheerful.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，阳光正好。防晒补水，享受舒适，保持好心情。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, perfect weather. Protect from sun, hydrate, enjoy the day!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，气温舒适。早晚添衣，注意保暖，保持活力哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast and mild. Add layers morning/evening, stay warm and energetic!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，风力较大。出门注意防风，小心着凉，保护自己。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast with strong winds. Watch out for wind, avoid catching a cold, stay safe.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛小雨，风力适中。出门带伞，路滑小心，保持好心情。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has light rain and moderate wind. Remember your umbrella, watch for slippery roads.
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 5级

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，气温舒适。湿度高，外出注意防潮，保持舒适。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy with pleasant temperature. High humidity, stay comfortable.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦阴天，风力适中。出门记得多喝水，享受美好一天！
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is overcast with moderate wind. Remember to drink water and enjoy your day!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 大雨伴强风，体感较凉。请务必带伞，注意出行安全哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Heavy rain and strong winds make it feel cool. Please take an umbrella and stay safe!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 7级
